name: Capitulation positioning flush: deep-negative funding + extreme fear (NOT fear-alone)
rationale: Thesis: Fear&Greed-alone contrarian is exhausted — it fires on shallow dips and gives back the edge. The orthogonal claim is that the rare day where sentiment fear AND leveraged-positioning capitulation COINCIDE marks a true squeeze bottom: shorts crowded (funding deeply negative, paying longs) at the same moment the crowd is maximally fearful. Entry (long-only spot): funding_rate < deeply-negative floor [-0.006,-0.0005] AND fear_greed < an extreme floor. DISCONFIRMER #1: must beat fear_greed<floor ALONE — if lone-fear matches net Sharpe, the funding gate is worthless and this is F&G-dip rebuilt. DISCONFIRMER #2: must beat deep-funding ALONE — to prove the sentiment confirm is not redundant with positioning. The COMPOSITE must beat BOTH single-feature ablations after 10bps fees. funding_feature null — positioning level, not carry. Exit when fear normalizes (cross_up) or funding crosses back up.
catalyst: extreme-fear sentiment coinciding with a deep-negative funding (crowded-short) flush
